method: read-only source reachability/static review; no builds/tests/models/jobs/network; source/config/docs/Git/index unchanged
known_in_flight_exclusions: quoridor-d3g documentation retirement and knowledge consolidation

findings.title: Frozen native SHA does not bind the checkpoint and scale actually evaluated by test
findings.evidence: Public train test CLI checks best-model native manifest/weights SHA, but builds from config.json/scale.json and loads initial.pt/best.pt; result candidate_sha is the native weights digest. Same-state emission at train.py:739-752 protects the normal immediate post-training case. Nonpersistent buffers make scale/coefficient edits affect evaluated values. No checkpoint/config/scale binding check was found in this entrypoint or reachable callers.
findings.root_cause: Frozen descriptor and Python evaluation inputs have separate unverified identities.
findings.impact: A same-topology checkpoint mix-up or scale/config edit can change measured predictions while retaining the reported frozen candidate SHA; existing recorded results are not proven corrupt.
findings.recommendation: Use one authoritative model descriptor, or hash-bind and verify all consumed checkpoints/model config/scale/target/baselines plus test data before evaluation; retain native parity and reject changed inputs with small fixtures.
findings.verification: Static call/data-flow and buffer persistence review; no NN execution. External immutable archives may protect specific historical runs but are not enforced by this CLI.

findings.title: Sharded cache concatenates the entire dense corpus into RAM
findings.evidence: File input routes load→_load_sharded; child tensors are memmaps but return np.concatenate for x/d/y. All rows are JSON lists and copied metadata dictionaries. Feature copy alone costs rows*2*312*4 bytes: 2,496,000,000 bytes per million rows.
findings.root_cause: Batch-oriented training API requires one dense global array; shard abstraction is lost during load.
findings.impact: Host RAM and initialization cost grow with corpus size before training; three million rows require 7,488,000,000 feature-copy bytes plus metadata/framework/mapped resident pages. No actual OOM is claimed.
findings.recommendation: Provide shard-aware bounded batch lookup and bounded metadata while preserving hashes/partitions/exposure rules; update callers rather than preserving parallel legacy dense APIs. Human approval remains required for dataset scale/selection experiments.
findings.verification: Source and byte arithmetic only; RSS/throughput/GPU costs unmeasured.

findings.title: Direct cycle interruption has weaker child cleanup than its timeout path
findings.evidence: Cycle creates new child sessions. Timeout sends TERM/KILL/wait; generic finally sends TERM plus wait(timeout=3), without KILL on timeout. No SIGTERM handler runs cleanup. Child log files use unlimited direct output streams. Outer research-job periodically records descendants and cleans them by identity, so wrapper protection differs from direct CLI.
findings.root_cause: Cycle lifecycle/resource handling is spread across separate stage and outer-wrapper paths.
findings.impact: Direct Ctrl-C/SIGTERM may leave detached stage work alive; a TERM-resistant child may escape generic exception cleanup. Stage log/RAM/output/pause limits are not enforced as a whole-cycle contract. Wrapper runs are not asserted to always orphan.
findings.recommendation: Own stage child identity and use one TERM→KILL→wait routine for signal/exception/timeout; unify whole-cycle resource, pause and bounded-log handling; verify with artificial short processes in a separate authorized repair.
findings.confidence: high for source gap; medium for actual orphan extent
findings.verification: Static review only; no process or job launched. Outer exact-descendant cleanup is an existing mitigating protection.

findings.title: Lightweight research gate omits maintained NN0 test modules
findings.evidence: Training source is discovered for syntax/format but executed suite names only quoridor_training.test_contracts. Maintained selected_target/residual_config/sampling/plotting/sharded_cache regressions are not called. Observation module contains NN0 contracts and opt-in Torch tests, so unconditional discovery is not the safe replacement. Product check also omits its available audio settings contract script.
findings.root_cause: Test execution remains a hand-picked old module while source discovery expanded.
findings.impact: Selected-label/provenance/sharded-partition/config regressions can pass the documented routine gate; maintainers must recover individual test commands. Browser audio tests exist, so this is not total audio absence.
findings.recommendation: Define an explicit maintained NN0 suite with registration coverage and a separate opt-in model suite; include inexpensive audio persistence tests in the product gate.
findings.verification: Static entrypoint-to-test comparison; existing test pass/fail not evaluated.

findings.title: Product check selects the complete native research workspace
findings.evidence: npm check repeats cargo check/clippy --workspace for rules and AI. Workspace includes inference/data/runner; default inference compiles native/ort.cpp and links dl, runner uses Linux affinity APIs. Product Wasm builds themselves remain separate rules/AI artifacts.
findings.root_cause: One quality command binds product validation to research package selection.
findings.impact: UI/save changes inherit native research C++/Arrow/Linux environment preparation and failures; product-only checks and fresh-source verification cannot select a smaller package set. Linux research design itself is not rejected.
findings.recommendation: Keep shared crates/workspace; define separate product and native research package gates plus an integration entrypoint that invokes both when needed. Preserve DTO/fixtures/strict TS and separate Wasm feature checks.
findings.confidence: high for dependency selection; medium for platform impact
findings.verification: Static manifests/build script review; build duration and cross-platform failure unmeasured.

findings.title: DevContainer startup still requires unused Godot and unconditional training setup
findings.evidence: Build/post-create installs and updates Godot plus export templates and requires Godot/GDScript tools. No current project.godot/.gd/.cs source was found; verify_env explicitly allows project absence. Container/update code handles arm64 but unconditional training setup rejects non-x86_64.
findings.root_cause: Original environment-template obligations remain in common product/research startup.
findings.impact: Container recreation pays unused toolchain/template acquisition and shared training setup; arm64 recreation stops even for product-only work. Latest-stable policy is not itself the finding.
findings.recommendation: Confirm actual external use, then retire Godot installation/update/check/dead headless paths together and separate common product initialization from explicit research environment acquisition. Preserve NVIDIA/research caches, shared Beads and persistent assets.
findings.verification: Source reachability and startup chain only; rebuild/download sizes/times and external Godot use unverified.

findings.title: Initial compatibility probe and Wasm JSON API have no repository callers
findings.evidence: distance_to_goal is documented as phase0 probe; initial_position_json is documented as a retained compatibility entrypoint and still exported with rules. Search over current source/tests/scripts found definitions only. RulesGame new/get_view supplies the current initial position.
findings.root_cause: Retired compatibility obligations survive beside authoritative DTO/Game APIs.
findings.impact: Small unnecessary API surface and a second hand-written initial-position JSON representation add maintenance decisions.
findings.recommendation: Remove both unused repository entrypoints; retain only if a concrete external consumer is established with explicit removal conditions. Do not remove active standard Game/B0/MCTS/NNUE functionality.
findings.confidence: high for repository caller absence; medium for external ABI usage
findings.verification: Scoped source search only; external Wasm consumers not inspectable.
